name: Sea Trials
description: Commission the Aqua Nova: take her to the Trials AO, test her depth and speed, and report to OERA.

objectives.description: Make a waypoint inside the Trials AO box (NAV page: Dest, then Lat / Long) and tap Plot
Sail into the Trials AO, about 100 nm south (no faster than 15 knots)

onComplete.text: We are in the AO, Captain. The engineering computer and super cruise are signed off. Have a look at the fusion drive in Engineering before we open her up. OERA's trials orders are in your mail.

message.subject: Welcome to the AO
message.text:
{captain},

Welcome to the AO. There are friendly vessels in the area while testing is being conducted. You may be the most formidable ship out there, but not everyone wants to see you succeed. The Aqua Nova is still untested and your crew still new.

You are to push the limits of speed and figure out where they are. Computer models and theory can only take us so far. The Aqua Nova has a state-of-the-art hull skin, designed for high-speed supercavitation, paired with a new hydro-jet propulsion system and a quantum fusion drive to power you. You should be able to get over 100 knots.

Chief Doyle has signed off the engineering computer and super cruise. Take her to 300 meters, the first step of her depth certification, run her at full speed, then engage super cruise. The shelf is shallow to the north, so run south over deep water. When you are done, come up to 15 meters or shallower and send us your trials report.

Admiral Catherine Okafor
Director of Operations, O.E.R.A.

objectives.description: Check the fusion drive on the engineering computer (the console in Engineering)
In the AO, take her down to 300 m: the first depth certification step
Run at full speed (13 knots or faster)
Engage super cruise and reach 100 knots (run south, over deep water)
Come up to 15 m or shallower, so the antenna has a link
Transmit your trials report from the Comms station

message.subject: Sea trials: report received
message.text: Report received. Good work, Captain. The Aqua Nova passes her trials and is commissioned. Bring her home. On the way, Dr. Patel and the sensors team want to try their equipment at Vineyard Ledge. Your first survey assignment will follow.

hints.message: The Trials AO is the amber box on the chart, {captain}. On the NAV page tap Dest, choose Lat / Long and enter a point inside it, for example 39 54 N, 71 00 W. Then tap Plot and set a speed at the Helm.
It is a long way at 14 knots, {captain}. Order me to take the con and get some rest, or speed up time in Settings.
The engineering computer is the console in Engineering, {captain}: walkway AN-1, the door on the right.
Super cruise is on the Helm station, or ask Marcus. Head south first, {captain}: it needs deep water ahead.

logBriefing: My orders from Admiral Okafor: commission the Aqua Nova. Depart Woods Hole for the Trials AO on the edge of the shelf, about 100 miles south, keeping under 15 knots and 300 metres on the way. In the AO: test depth, full speed and super cruise, then send the trials report from Comms.
logOutcome: We reached the Trials AO, took her to 300 metres, ran her at full speed and opened her up in super cruise. I sent the trials report to OERA from {location} and the Aqua Nova is commissioned.
